description: This file defines a React functional component 'U2FAddDeviceView' for adding a U2F device, including user input handling, modal rendering, and device registration logic.

classes.name: U2FAddDeviceView
classes.description: A React FunctionComponent for adding a U2F device, managing device name input, errors, and invoking authenticator logic.

methods.name: handleDeviceNameChange
methods.description: Updates the deviceName state when the input changes.

methods.name: handleAddDeviceClick
methods.description: Validates input and attempts to add the U2F device via the addAuthenticator execute method; manages success and error cases.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the modal by toggling its visibility to false.
